finding: The site queue correctly records status=failed and return_code=1 for the12 sampled-budget refusals. The release/report gates incorrectly required completed for every terminal model job.
correction: Require completed/zero for audited within-budget points and failed/nonzero for independently audited sampled-budget refusals; retain classification, raw queue/status files, exit codes and original failures unchanged.
